reconstruction_policy: No source geometry/restart/mesh/time step is modified. Short-loop timing is not full-episode physical or evaluator certification; any later membership or physical protocol change is separately versioned.

selection_policy.primary: Preserve distinct 3D/2D control phenomena and meaningful parameter variations under practical measured cost.
selection_policy.limit_scope: Organizer membership-screening rule on this H100 measurement, not an agent/evaluator per-step timeout.
selection_policy.source_assets: All source files and initial states for each retained case; shared train/eval copy.
selection_policy.physics: No mesh coarsening or CFD substep/timestep changes for speed; class/YAML discrepancies remain explicit until protocol acceptance.
selection_policy.cost_warning: Different control steps advance different physical intervals; full-episode and full-suite costs still require measurement.
selection_policy.readiness: Complete short loop is required, but is not full evaluator or physical validation.
selection_policy.scoring: Every selected case is mandatory; no optional expensive track, no per-model subset or per-task expert checkpoint.
